description: This PHP file defines the HasEveryBinary class in the Twig templating engine, specifically as a binary expression node for the Twig parser. It extends AbstractBinary and implements code generation for a 'has every' condition check, involving array evaluation via CoreExtension::arrayEvery.

classes.name: HasEveryBinary
classes.description: A class representing a binary expression node in Twig that checks if every element matches a condition, compiled into PHP code using the CoreExtension::arrayEvery method.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the 'has every' binary expression using the provided Compiler object.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the operator token for this binary expression, which is empty in this implementation.
